live.title: Coffee bag photos become structured data automatically
live.detail: Take a photo of a bag and the backend reads off the roaster, origin, farm, process, price, weight and rating for you.

live.title: Extraction now runs for free
live.detail: Photo extraction moved off paid Vertex AI onto Gemini's free developer tier — no more spend caps to manage, and it costs $0.

live.title: Extraction picks are applied by default
live.detail: The engine's picks land directly on the coffee instead of sitting in a review queue, and implausible values (like a 2m altitude) are dropped instead of shown; review only shows genuine disagreements between voters.

live.title: Any coffee field can be corrected, right in the app
live.detail: Roaster, farm, origin, process, price, weight, rating and roast date can all be fixed from an in-app edit sheet with vocab dropdowns — corrections save for real, not just locally.

live.title: Farm names are learned automatically
live.detail: A confident new farm name from a caption now creates its own vocabulary entry instead of being dropped; farm coverage jumped from 0/21 to 13/21 coffees on the first run.

live.title: Roaster countries filled in — and a caption beats a guess
live.detail: Most known roasters now have a home country on file, including Switzerland, Hong Kong, Japan and Greece; an explicit caption like 'Amsterdam, Olanda' now overrides a mistaken vocab guess.

live.title: Smaller cached photos
live.detail: On-device photo thumbnails shrank about 57% to stay comfortably under the app's 50 MB size budget.

live.title: Full-text search actually searches everything now
live.detail: Roaster, origin, farm, process and the bag's own caption/description text are all indexed for search — it used to silently return nothing because the index was never populated.

live.title: Image-only bag photos get a readable transcription
live.detail: Photos with no caption or description get an OCR pass so the bag's text is still readable in the app, with a daily routine automatically draining the backlog of stragglers.

live.title: Insights got a redesign
live.detail: Three sub-tabs (Insights / Charts / Data), a time-window control (All / last 12m / last 18m / by year), and an average rating shown next to every breakdown, down to each chart legend.

live.title: See what's shipped and what's next, from inside the app
live.detail: A Live/Plan screen reachable from Settings — this is that screen, reading its own data straight from the backend.

live.title: The coffee page got a real header
live.detail: Bare white photo controls, a roaster logo medallion, fractional star ratings, and a FROM THE ROASTER facts grid instead of a 'Full text' link.

live.title: Roaster pages have logos and readable blurbs
live.detail: 64 roasters now carry a logo and a written blurb; the markdown the blurbs arrived in is rendered as label/value rows instead of showing raw asterisks.

live.title: Value reads at a glance
live.detail: The five value outcomes each get their own tone on a near-black to accent-blue ramp, so OVERPAID and GREAT VALUE read apart without counting pills. Rating now outweighs price 65/35 in the score.

live.title: Filter and sort by value
live.detail: Cheap-for-quality is a real filter dimension and a sort order now, plus its own donut in Insights — 'show me only the great-value bags' is one tap.

live.title: Brew lab
live.detail: Log what you brewed each coffee with — recipe, device, grind and water temperature — and crown a winner per kind. The coffee page shows the four winners at a glance; Settings has the catalogue.

live.title: The coffee list starts higher and says what it's filtering
live.detail: Shorter rows, a tighter header, an unmistakably 'on' filter button, and a line telling you which filters are actually applied. Review and chip counts now follow the filter instead of staying library-wide.

live.title: Runs on iPad, and rotates
live.detail: One universal app rather than a second one — it now runs natively on iPad instead of letterboxed, and rotates to landscape on both.

live.title: Add a coffee without waiting
live.detail: The Add Coffee wizard saves and returns immediately; extraction finishes in the background and the coffee shows an 'Extracting…' badge until it does.

live.title: A browser extension that scores a coffee while you shop
live.detail: Open a roaster's product page and get its fit, value and freshness against your own library, plus a ranked history of the last coffees you looked at.

live.title: Bag text is no longer lost
live.detail: Re-running extraction used to wipe the OCR transcription appended to a coffee; it is kept now, and it is searchable.

live.title: Prices and altitudes read correctly
live.detail: Romanian lei, Czech koruna, zloty, forint and the Nordic currencies now parse with their currency attached, and a roast date can no longer be mistaken for an altitude range.
